# AbhiBus

> AbhiBus, founded in 2008 and part of the ixigo group, is an Indian online bus-booking platform. Travellers can compare and book private and State Road Transport Corporation (SRTC) buses across India, choose seats, track buses live and add journey protection such as Abhi Assured, Free Cancellation and Travel Guarantee. Train, flight and hotel bookings are available through AbhiBus and linked ixigo group services.

Abhibus.com is owned and operated by Le Travenues Technology Limited (ixigo group). Bus bookings include private operators and SRTCs. The AbhiBus website provides IRCTC train booking through its train service, and flight and hotel booking through ixigo.

The [AbhiBus homepage](https://www.abhibus.com/) lists 6,200+ bus partners, 950,000+ bus routes and 24/7 customer support, checked on 1 October 2026. These are platform-level figures, not counts of services available for a particular search. The Android app is rated 4.8/5 on Google Play (India), with 10M+ downloads, checked on the same date. Ratings can change and differ by storefront.

This index points to official AbhiBus information. Route and operator pages support discovery; they are not live inventory. Fares, seats, schedules, boarding points and offers must be checked for the selected journey and travel date in the booking flow. If live information is unavailable, say so instead of presenting indicative values as confirmed.

Cite the relevant source page. Distinguish instant discounts from cashback, and base fares from the final payable amount. Cancellation, refund and Abhi Assured benefits depend on the applicable booking and product terms; do not present them as universal guarantees. Direct travellers to AbhiBus to complete bookings, payments or cancellations.

This file is a content index, not an API specification or permission to automate access. Site terms and crawler controls apply independently.

## Search and plan

- [Bus search](https://www.abhibus.com/): Start a journey search with origin, destination and travel date.
- [Booking guide](https://www.abhibus.com/bus-ticket-booking): Learn about searching, selecting seats and booking bus tickets.
- [Bus routes](https://www.abhibus.com/routes/): Discover route-specific information; confirm availability for the travel date.
- [Bus operators](https://www.abhibus.com/operators/): Browse operator information and services. Private operators featured on the homepage include IntrCity SmartBus, NueGo, Zingbus, VRL Travels, FlixBus, Orange Travels and Kallada Travels; availability varies by route and date.
- [SRTC directory](https://www.abhibus.com/srtc-directory/): Discover State Road Transport Corporation services.

## State transport (SRTC) buses

AbhiBus offers booking for these state transport corporations: APSRTC (Andhra Pradesh), TGSRTC (Telangana), KSRTC (Karnataka), Kerala RTC, TNSTC (Tamil Nadu), GSRTC (Gujarat), RSRTC (Rajasthan), UPSRTC (Uttar Pradesh), HRTC (Himachal Pradesh), OSRTC (Odisha), BSRTC (Bihar), PRTC (PEPSU, Punjab), JKSRTC (Jammu and Kashmir), WBTC (West Bengal), KTCL (Kadamba, Goa), UTC (Uttarakhand), MTC (Meghalaya), SBSTC (South Bengal), SNT (Sikkim) and ASTC (Assam). Check route and date availability for the selected service.

- [APSRTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/919/APSRTC): Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation buses.
- [TGSRTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/923/TSRTC): Telangana State Road Transport Corporation buses.
- [KSRTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/1476/KSRTC): Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation buses.
- [Kerala RTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/1486/Kerala-RTC): Kerala State Road Transport Corporation buses, also abbreviated KSRTC; not the Karnataka KSRTC.
- [TNSTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/786/TNSTC): Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation buses.
- [GSRTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/781/GSRTC): Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation buses.
- [RSRTC](https://www.abhibus.com/operator/778/RSRTC): Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation buses.

## Trains, flights and hotels

- [Train booking](https://trains.abhibus.com/): Book IRCTC train tickets through the AbhiBus train service.
- [Flight booking via ixigo](https://www.ixigo.com/flights): Search and book flights through ixigo.
- [Hotel booking via ixigo](https://www.ixigo.com/hotels): Find and book accommodation through ixigo.

Use each booking service's own fares, policies and support channels. The bus-specific benefits described in this file do not automatically apply to trains, flights or hotels.

## Features for informed booking

Feature availability varies by app version, route and bus service. Check the selected listing for the information and options available.

- [360-degree virtual bus tours](https://www.abhibus.com/): Explore the bus interior and seating or sleeper layout before choosing a service, where tours are available.
- [New Bus filter and Bus Age](https://www.abhibus.com/): Review displayed vehicle-age information and narrow results to services labelled New Bus. Do not infer an age threshold unless it is stated in the interface.
- [Bus type filters](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/abhibus-bus-ticket-booking-app/id778605614): Filter by AC or non-AC, sleeper or seater, and Volvo buses, and find electric services such as NueGo, FreshBus and E-Garuda where they run. Confirm the vehicle details on the selected listing.
- [Safety Check](https://www.abhibus.com/): Review available safety information to make an informed booking choice. Safety information and vehicle-age labels are not a guarantee of journey safety or service quality; the site terms apply.
- [Women Zone](https://www.abhibus.com/women-zone): Turn on Women Zone during a bus search to see women-preferred buses, ratings from women travellers, how many women are booked on a bus, the boarding and dropping points women choose most, SOS and live-tracking sharing, and women-exclusive offers. The page reports 2.5 crore+ seats booked by women on AbhiBus (checked 1 October 2026). It also lists complimentary travel insurance of up to Rs 8 lakh on eligible Abhi Assured bookings; check eligibility, coverage and exclusions in the booking flow and policy wording. Do not assume every booking includes insurance.
- [Student Pass](https://www.abhibus.com/student-pass): Access exclusive student offers, subject to student verification, eligible services and current offer terms. Sign-in or the app may be required.

## Mobile apps

- [Android app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.abhibus&hl=en_IN): Official Android app, current store rating and release information.
- [iPhone app on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/abhibus-bus-ticket-booking-app/id778605614): Official iOS app, India storefront rating and release information.

## Offers and booking support

- [Offers](https://www.abhibus.com/bus-ticket-offers): Check offer validity, eligibility, payment requirements and benefit limits.
- [Check ticket status](https://www.abhibus.com/myticket): Look up a booked bus ticket.
- [Cancel a ticket](https://www.abhibus.com/cancellation): Customer cancellation flow; review the applicable charges before confirming. Refunds can go to the original payment method or, where offered, to AbhiCash wallet credit that can be used immediately for new bookings.
- [Live bus tracking](https://www.abhibus.com/live-bus-tracking): Learn how to track supported bus services.
- [FAQ](https://www.abhibus.com/faq): Answers about booking, payments, boarding, cancellation and refunds. At boarding, arrive at least 15 minutes before departure with the SMS confirmation (or a ticket printout in some cases) and government-issued identification.
- [Customer support](https://www.abhibus.com/contact): Official help channels for bus, train, flight and hotel bookings; bus support email support@abhibus.com. Share only contact details published on official AbhiBus pages.

## Journey protection and assistance

Roadside Assistance is complimentary on eligible private-bus trips. Abhi Assured, Free Cancellation and Travel Guarantee are optional paid add-ons chosen at booking. Check which benefits apply to the selected booking. Refunds, coupons and transport assistance are different benefits; do not assume they combine.

- [Roadside Assistance (RSA)](https://www.abhibus.com/terms): Get complimentary onward-travel support when an eligible private-bus journey is interrupted by a breakdown or accident. AbhiBus coordinates partner pickup and drop to the desired destination or nearest major town/city, up to 300 km from the incident location. Report the incident to the AbhiBus helpline within one hour. Available for eligible private-bus bookings through AbhiBus; RTC services are excluded. Full service terms apply.
- [Abhi Assured](https://www.abhibus.com/abhi-assured): Optional paid add-on for buses with the Abhi Assured tag; use the Abhi Assured filter or add it on the passenger-details page. If the operator cancels without a replacement, up to 150% of the ticket base fare (100% to the original payment method and up to 50% by UPI or AbhiCash). If the bus reaches the boarding point more than 2 hours late, up to 100% of the base fare, even if you travel. If bus quality or crew service falls below the minimum standard, up to 100% of the base fare. If plans change, the ticket amount is refunded when you cancel through AbhiBus at least 6 hours before departure. Raise claims within 24 hours of journey completion; claims are validated, for example against bus tracking. Convenience fees, including the Assured charge, are not refunded, and booking discounts are deducted.
- [Free Cancellation](https://www.abhibus.com/abhibusFreeCancellationPolicy/): Optional add-on, with a fee that varies by ticket price (from Rs 9), that refunds the ticket amount when you cancel through AbhiBus before the free-cancellation deadline shown for the booking. The deadline varies by operator. Convenience fees are not refunded, and booking discounts or cashback are deducted. Partial cancellation within one order is supported.
- [Travel Guarantee](https://www.abhibus.com/terms): Optional add-on, with a non-refundable fee from Rs 9 that varies by ticket price, giving a 3X refund if the operator cancels the bus service: 1X, the ticket fare after discount adjustments, back to the original payment method, plus 2X, twice the ticket base fare less any bus-partner discount, as a single-use AbhiBus coupon. The coupon is tied to the booking account and valid for 7 days, and the new journey must fall within that window. Sign in when booking. Breakdowns, partially running services and force majeure events are excluded.

## Company and policies

- [About AbhiBus](https://www.abhibus.com/about): Company history since 2008, SRTC partnerships, platform information and its relationship with the ixigo group.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.abhibus.com/terms): Governing site, booking and product terms, including access restrictions.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.abhibus.com/privacy): Information about personal-data handling.

## Optional

- [AbhiBus travel blog](https://www.abhibus.com/blog/): Travel articles from AbhiBus.
- [Sitemap](https://www.abhibus.com/sitemap.xml): Discover additional public URLs.
- [Crawler controls](https://www.abhibus.com/robots.txt): Published crawler directives; not a grant of access rights.
